stories.story_fr: Kraft Heinz annonce un investissement de 600 millions de dollars dans le marketing, les ventes et la R&D pour relancer la croissance rentable, et met en pause le projet de scission de la societe.
stories.story_en: Kraft Heinz announced a $600 million investment across Marketing, Sales, and R&D to return to profitable growth, and paused the work related to its planned separation.
stories.signal: Announces $600 Million Investment in Commercial Levers to Return to Profitable Growth Pauses Work Related to Separation

stories.story_fr: Apres avoir vise une scission en deux societes au second semestre 2026, la direction juge prudent de mettre en pause ce projet pour concentrer toutes les ressources sur le redressement du business americain.
stories.story_en: After targeting a split into two companies in H2 2026, management deemed it prudent to pause the separation to focus all resources on the U.S. business turnaround.
stories.signal: we believe it is prudent to pause work related to the separation and we will no longer incur related dis-synergies this year

stories.story_fr: L'exercice 2025 affiche une perte operationnelle de 4,7 milliards de dollars, tiree par des depreciations non monetaires de 9,3 milliards de dollars.
stories.story_en: FY2025 posted a $4.7 billion operating loss, driven by $9.3 billion of non-cash impairment losses.
stories.signal: Operating Income (Loss) was a loss of $4.7 billion, driven by non-cash impairment losses of $9.3 billion
